name: Boiron SA
summary: Boiron SA manufactures and sells homeopathic medicines in France, rest of Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers homeopathic medicines and homeopathic specialties; and other healthcare products, including medical devices (in vitro diagnostics), dietary supplements, herbal remedies, cosmetics, and CBD-based products.
